Women's ITF World Tennis Tour
Girls ITF World Tennis Tour Juniors

Sleeves
2 positions individually measuring 6 in²/39 cm² for commercial AND/OR manufacturer's IDs on each sleeve.
*max. of 2 IDs within each 6 in²/39 cm² position

Compression sleeves
(In addition to the IDs on the sleeves)
2 manufacturer's IDs of 2 in²/13 cm²
OR
1 manufacturer's ID of 4 in²/26 cm²

[Diagram showing close-up detail of a shirt sleeve labeled with positions for IDs]
On the sleeve diagram:
SLEEVE
POSITION 1:
ID 1 | ID 2
6 in²/39 cm²

POSITION 2:
ID 3 | ID 4
6 in²/39 cm²

SHIRTS, SWEATER, JACKET, DRESS

Front, back and collar
2 manufacturer's or commercial IDs of 6 in²/39 cm² on front or collar
OR
1 manufacturer's or commercial ID of 6 in²/39 cm² on front or collar AND 1 manufacturer's ID of 4 in²/26 cm² on the back

Other
Manufacturer's ID without any writing may be placed once or repeatedly within an area not to exceed 12 in²/77.5 cm² in one of the locations:
• each of the shirt sleeves (which replaces 1 of the positions for commercial or manufacturer IDs on each sleeve)
• outer seams (sides of torso) of the shirt

Without sleeves
4 manufacturer's or commercial IDs of 6 in²/39 cm² on front or collar only if max 3 IDs are placed on the front and 2 of those are commercial
OR
3 manufacturer's or commercial IDs of 6 in²/39 cm² on front or collar + 1 manufacturer's ID of 4 in²/26 cm² on the back - if max 2 IDs on the front are commercial

A Position is an area on players clothing within which identification(s) may be placed.
An Identification (ID) is a logo of the brand which may contain writing unless stated otherwise. Identifications may be either manufacturer or commercial (non-manufacturer).

Revised March 2024
